title: Cthos — Android Permissions Manifest
note: These permissions are declared declaratively here for audit/planning. Actual runtime grant is handled via expo-permissions/config plugins in later phases. Native-access taps, DND toggle, screen capture, accessibility gestures require native bridge config plugins (custom Expo modules) that are NOT enabled until STEP 4.

core.purpose: Realtime voice engine — capture microphone stream for STT & conversation.
Cloud STT/TTS, media APIs (Spotify/YouTube), EAS Update.
Keep voice-engine sub-agent awake during background conversations.
Android 14+ foreground service type for continuous mic capture.
Prevent CPU sleep during real-time streaming & macro playback.
Detect connectivity for offline fallback / music streaming.

system_permissions_planned.purpose: Overlay buttons — caller-ID banner & hands-free call control.
Device automation: tapping, typing, scrolling, screen reading.
Read unread chat/call notifications for WhatsApp automation.
